title: Programme — Day One
key_sentences: Welcome to the second annual conference of the Northshore Library Network.
This year’s theme is reading in a changing community.
All sessions in the Lecture Theatre will be recorded and published within two weeks.
Please wear your badge at all times while in the building.

rows: Opening remarks Director, Northshore Library Network
Keynote: The library as a third place Dr Amara Lindqvist-Obi
Workshop A: Running a repair café Workshop B: Story time for multilingual families
Lightning talks Six speakers, ten minutes each

list_items.text: Lunch is served in the Atrium from 12:30.
Cloakroom on the ground floor, next to the lifts.
Quiet room: Room 1.02, open all day.
Step-free access from the Quay Street entrance.
